svg.title: openmeet-core / openmeet-intel: answer-integrity flag, signals and the sidecar contract

g.text: openmeet-core / openmeet-intel: answer-integrity flag, signals and the sidecar contract
note: built by the Tauri command get_integrity_status, not by the trait
Not scored: too_short, baseline, no_gaze, unavailable.
Only the scored ones take part in the combined flag.
high: a calibrated signal is high AND at least
one other signal is possible or high.
possible: any signal possible or high.
An uncalibrated signal counts at most as possible.
A signal for the interviewer, never a verdict.
headline is one plain line; signals carry the evidence.
One flag per checked answer; a re-check replaces it
